subject: maths
question: A piece of land in the form of a rectangle has dimensions 240 m × 180 m. A narrow strip 10 m wide is dug all around it (outside) and the earth dug out is evenly spread over the land, increasing its surface level by 25 cm. Find the depth of the strip, rounded off to two decimal places.
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Area of rectangular strip (outside) = 2w(L + B + 2w) = 2 × 10(240 + 180 + 20) = 8800 m² Volume of earth spread = Area of land × Rise in level = 240 × 180 × 0.25 = 10800 m³ Volume dug = Volume spread ⇒ Area of strip × Depth = 10800 Depth = 10800 ÷ 8800 = 1.227... **∴ The correct answer is 1.23 m.**
